section_summary.extract_value: This section details the procedure for a single study. Participants received a baseline questionnaire and paper diaries via mail, with trained research assistants providing phone instructions. They completed the baseline questionnaire first, then started daily diaries the next day, receiving daily reminders. Completed materials were returned using pre-paid envelopes to ensure compliance.
